summary: Round-2 verdict: APPROVED. The Wave 1 critical conflict on application.properties is resolved (Task 1 now owns both property additions in one pass; Task 2 no longer lists application.properties in Files to modify). All three reviewer-set findings (Tasks 4, 5, 7) are resolved: every code-writing task now carries the default reviewer set code-reviewer + security-auditor + test-reviewer. Wave conflict re-scan: Wave 1 has zero file overlaps across the five tasks (TokenEncryptor + props + .env.example | TelegramApiClient + DTOs + build.gradle | Bot domain | locale JSONs | Settings route folder split). Wave 2 (BotService backend vs bot store frontend) is disjoint. Wave 3 (BotController backend vs settings/bot.vue frontend + shadcn-vue dialog/* new files + package.json) is disjoint -- Task 9's new components/ui/dialog/* directory is generated by the shadcn-vue CLI and touched by no other Wave 3 task. Cross-wave: Task 5 creates the placeholder settings/bot.vue in Wave 1 and Task 9 replaces it in Wave 3 -- sequential by design. Remaining findings are the three task-brevity minors carried over from round 1; they are informational and do not block approval.
